rules.title: Dining area in North
rules.explanation: The dining area is traditionally preferred near the kitchen while keeping the centre unobstructed.
rules.practical_impact: Provides traceable Knowledge coverage for dining area placement.
rules.architectural_note: Keep circulation between kitchen and dining practical during redesign.
rules.existing_home_note: Use a clean, well-lit dining area and avoid placing it in a congested central passage.
rules.source_note: Belief-based guidance; interpretations and schools may vary.
